description: A project's claims — its theorems, lemmas, propositions, corollaries, conjectures and questions — each with its label (what a paper's \label and a citation name it by, e.g. 'thm:d5-rank5'), its number in the paper, its statement (Markdown with formulas), how far it is proved and what it rests on. 'status' is on one fixed scale: 'open' (not proved), 'paper' (proved on paper), 'computer' (by a computation), 'lean' (formalised in Lean), 'refuted', 'retracted' (taken back — the † of a result). A basis is a wiki page with the proof ('page', its id and title — or 'hidden' where you may not open the page), a computation by the name a [comp:…] cites ('computation'), a Lean declaration ('lean') or a source in words ('source'). This register is where a claim's status is kept: read it here rather than from a page's words, and change it with set_claim_status. Ordered by number, then label. Anybody who sees the project.

kind.description: Only claims of this kind: theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, conjecture, question.

q.description: Words its label, number, title or statement holds, case aside.

status.description: Only claims of this status: open, paper, computer, lean, refuted, retracted.

name: list_claims
